title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice J. C. Doshi from 25.11.2026 to 27.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 23/11/2026
25.11.2026 to 27.11.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 23/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-04/2026
It is hereby notified that ;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. C. Doshi would not be available from
25.11.2026 to 27.11.2026.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Mool Chand
Tyagi) would take up the matters notified in the Cause list
of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. C. Doshi)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
